verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a documented Developer API with OpenAPI spec, LLM-readable docs, an official MCP server, and even a public CLI, indicating broad programmatic access aligned with AI-native workflows. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence that every UI capability (e.g., hotel rebooking automation, contract intake AI, dynamic approval routing) is fully exposed via the API — only general API/ERP sync and CSV export mentions. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or independent verification of full feature parity between API and UI, and evidence covering advanced workflow features (approvals, travel, intake) being API-accessible.
